schema:
CREATE TABLE members (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, member_code INTEGER UNIQUE, joined_date TEXT(255));
CREATE TABLE records (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, member_code INTEGER, status TEXT(255), FOREIGN KEY (member_code) REFERENCES members(member_code));
correct_query: SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN r.status = 'active' THEN m.id ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(m.id) AS pct FROM members AS m INNER JOIN records AS r ON m.member_code = r.member_code WHERE SUBSTRING(m.joined_date, 1, 4) BETWEEN '2015' AND '2020'

expected_semantic_errors_to_be_caught.description: Casts SUBSTRING(joined_date, 1, 4) to INTEGER in BETWEEN predicate instead of lexicographical string range comparison
expected_semantic_errors_to_be_caught.query: SELECT (CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN r.status = 'active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100.0) / COUNT(m.member_code) AS pct FROM members AS m INNER JOIN records AS r ON m.member_code = r.member_code WHERE CAST(SUBSTRING(m.joined_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 2015 AND 2020
